section: India and Nepal, Bhutan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, Maldives, Afghanistan

accepted.s: India launched which operation to provide assistance after the Nepal earthquake of 2015?
accepted.x: Operation Maitri was launched by India in response to the Nepal earthquake of 2015.
accepted.tq: Directly identify the operation associated with the specific crisis.

accepted.s: India provided approximately what amount of support to Sri Lanka during its economic crisis in 2022?
accepted.x: India extended support of approximately 4 billion US dollars to Sri Lanka during its economic crisis in 2022.
accepted.tq: Use the numerical figure associated with the crisis rather than confusing it with other assistance amounts.

accepted.s: Operation Cactus, launched by India in 1988, was associated with the foiling of a coup in which country?
accepted.x: Operation Cactus was the Indian operation that foiled a coup attempt in the Maldives in 1988.
accepted.tq: Match the named military operation with the country in which it was conducted.

accepted.s: After 2021, India's humanitarian assistance to Afghanistan included the supply of
accepted.x: India provided humanitarian assistance to Afghanistan after 2021 in the form of wheat and medicines.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific humanitarian commodities instead of selecting broader forms of aid.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding India's supply of COVID-19 vaccines to neighbouring countries:
1. Nepal received COVID-19 vaccines from India.
2. Bangladesh received COVID-19 vaccines from India.
3. Sri Lanka received COVID-19 vaccines from India.
4. Bhutan received COVID-19 vaccines from India.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: India supplied COVID-19 vaccines to all four countries listed: Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Bhutan.
accepted.tq: Check each country in the assistance list before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly reflects the current-relevance information concerning Bangladesh as of 16 February 2026?
o: Bangladesh's elected government is under Ibrahim Mohamed Solih.
Bangladesh's elected government is under Pushpa Kamal Dahal.
Bangladesh's elected government is under Tarique Rahman.
Bangladesh's elected government is under Mahinda Rajapaksa.
accepted.x: The current-relevance information identifies Bangladesh's elected government as being under Tarique Rahman on 16 February 2026.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between leaders associated with different South Asian countries.

accepted.s: Nepal's new government has been reported to be pushing for revision of which agreement with India?
o: The 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship
The 1947 Treaty of Peace and Friendship
The 1971 Treaty of Trade and Transit
accepted.x: Nepal's new government has been reported to be seeking revision of the 1950 treaty with India.
accepted.tq: Use the treaty year as the key discriminator among similar bilateral agreements.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below.

List-I (Country)
 a. Bangladesh
 b. China
 c. Nepal
 d. Bhutan

List-II (Length of border with India)
 i. 699 km
 ii. 4,096.7 km
 iii. 3,488 km
 iv. 1,751 km

Code:
accepted.x: Bangladesh has a 4,096.7 km border with India, China 3,488 km, Nepal 1,751 km and Bhutan 699 km.
accepted.tq: Start with the distinctive longest border and then verify the remaining country-length pairs.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the Buddhist International Tourism Circuit promoted in Andhra Pradesh?
o: It targets pilgrims from Sri Lanka, Myanmar and Thailand.
It targets pilgrims from Maldives, Nepal and Sri Lanka only.
It targets pilgrims from Nepal, Bhutan and Afghanistan only.
It targets pilgrims from Bangladesh, China and Pakistan only.
accepted.x: The Buddhist International Tourism Circuit in Andhra Pradesh targets pilgrims from Sri Lanka, Myanmar and Thailand.
accepted.tq: Apply the tourism-circuit concept by identifying its stated target pilgrim groups.
